Their expertise will make this [[QHLAN]] one to remember. This time, we're hosted in Black Molly Entertainment's fine '''[https://maps.app.goo.gl/ae4jSMSNEyHFsLLT8 venue in Segeltorp]''' – just 15 min south of Stockholm Central Station. Doors open on Wednesday, Jan 7th and close again on Sunday, Jan 11th. All tournaments will conclude late Saturday night, followed by a prize ceremony to celebrate the winners. You will be able to rent PC/monitors on site, or bring your own. ===Broadcast Talent=== {{Box|start|padding=5em}} '''Hosts:''' * {{player|Andeh|flag=se}} * {{player|Peppe|flag=se}} {{Box|break|padding=5em}} '''Casters:''' * {{player|Xerial|flag=se}} * {{player|Rio|flag=se}} {{Box|break|padding=5em}}
